name: Three reviewers, then a summary
description: Three specialists review the same input at once; a lead merges their reviews.

branches.instructions: Review the code in your input for security problems. List each finding with a severity.
Review the dependencies named in your input for outdated or risky packages.
Review the code in your input for readability and naming problems.

steps.instructions: Merge the three reviews in your input into one prioritised list.
